goal: Prevent frontends from falsely displaying successful sends when the node rejected a transaction
Allow user interfaces to detect transaction broadcast failures and inform users
agreement: No objections or concerns raised so far

categories.name: wallet
why: P3 because it prevents frontends from showing false success confirmations when transactions are rejected
Existing RPC and Qt widget behavior is kept intact limiting immediate user impact
Unblocks the QML GUI and future bump-transaction workflows from correctly detecting broadcast errors
